description:
Two-thumb keyboard: both thumbs swipe and tap at once. No network access.
Kinetica is a keyboard for two thumbs at once. Each thumb swipes or taps on its
own, at the same time as the other, and the two streams merge into one word.

Typing "something": the left thumb taps S, then E, while the right thumb swipes
O -> M and then T -> H -> I -> N -> G. Kinetica merges them into S + OM + E +
THING.

It is a spiritual successor to the discontinued Nintype, written from scratch on
Android's public IME APIs: not a fork, and no third-party gesture or prediction
library. The dynamic time warping, the trie search and the two-thumb merge are
all in the app.

The app declares no INTERNET permission, so nothing you type can leave the
phone. Decoding, prediction and learning run on the device, and password or
private fields turn off suggestions, trails and learning.

Features

* Two thumbs, each read with its own cursor, so a word can pass between them in
  any order; one tap can stand for a double letter
* Long words in one stroke or two thumbs, up to 40 letters, learned as you
  write them
* English, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Czech, Dutch, German, French, Norwegian
  and Romanian, plus Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew and Arabic as experimental: 46k
  to 50k words per language with real corpus frequencies. Accented words are
  drawn on their base keys and restored on commit
* Several languages at once: mix two in the suggestions, or let the keyboard
  follow the language you are typing, each word learned into its own
* A short setup on first open: languages, height, automatic space, theme and a
  two-thumb practice
* Settings in two groups, with search, a field to try the keyboard on every
  screen, and a list of what you changed with a way back
* Next-word suggestions beside the word's corrections, recent words on the
  bar, and a correction strip right after each word
* Tap inside a word you wrote to swap it for another; swipe shift to change
  its case
* An editing page: arrows, selection, word moves, undo and redo, the clipboard,
  each key yours to change
* Tap autocorrect with three levels; backspace right after it undoes it
* Your words rank higher as you use them; slide a suggestion to raise, lower or
  block it. Names you write with a capital keep it
* Chords on ?123 or the spacebar, edge swipes on any key, and text expansions:
  type text, run an action, or press Ctrl and a key
* 1 906 emoji with search in 14 languages, people and hands in the skin tone
  you choose
* Voice input through a voice keyboard you install: Kinetica itself records
  nothing and has no microphone permission
* Long-press menus as grids, with your own list for every letter and symbol,
  and symbol pages you can rewrite as text. The letter menus follow your
  languages: German on, and s offers ß
* A letter from a long-press menu stays in the word: ß, ő, the Italian schwa
* Keys that fit the field: @ in email fields, / and .com in web addresses,
  words as typed there, and an optional number pad for numbers
* Clean links: tracking parameters out of a link, as a shortcut or on paste
* Clipboard history, off by default: the last 20 copies, encrypted on the
  phone and never in a backup
* Optional numbers row, a wider middle row, landscape split, one-handed for
  either hand, split mode, adjustable height and margins; landscape keeps its
  own sizes
* Peck-type mode for slang and code: every tap types exactly its letter
* Dark, light, Material You or your own colour; key borders, keys that light
  up along a swipe, a background image, and a night look of its own
* Backup of every setting, learned word and shortcut in one file
* Settings in English and Italian, with short tips and a two-thumb tutor

Source, build instructions and the full feature list:
https://github.com/EZ-eta/kinetica

If Kinetica is useful to you: https://ko-fi.com/ez_eta
